a.xlink:title: bouquet physics workflow
a.text: Inputs (solid blue = required for its path, dashed = optional)

g.title: smooth
g.text: near-axis bootstrap repair (shared with the baseline)
the solver collapses the innermost surface point of
shelf-preserving Gaussian blend over the transition
⇒ a σ = 0 draw reproduces the baseline

g.title: eqfsa
g.text: flux-surface averages of the converged solve (no re-solve)

g.title: inspec
g.text: coil drift ≤ 2%; VSC via quadrature-propagated σ

g.title: idsout
g.text: otherwise the baseline flux-geometry ratio is used instead
